subject: English Home Language

source.subtopic: Phonemic awareness: segmenting words (hop into h-o-p)

show.line: Words break into sounds! Hop. h, o, p. Three sounds. Let's pull words apart.

rounds.prompt: Say the sounds in sun. s, u, n. How many sounds?
Say the sounds in at. How many sounds?
Which word has these sounds? d, o, g.

hints: Say the word very slowly. Hear each sound.
Tap a finger for each sound. h, o, p.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will say the sounds in cat.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! c, a, t. Three sounds.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's tap them together. c, a, t. Three!

parent_line: Can break a short word into its sounds.
